Subject: Request: Compliance-linked Sandbox Allowance for Org Horizon

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Horizon is ready to run a scoped Private/VPC evaluation but we have a couple of compliance gates to clear first. Our security team asked if Redwood can provide a short-term sandbox allowance that is explicitly tied to meeting certain evidence items (SOC 2 attestation + DPA) and isolation guarantees.

High level ask: a 30k-token promotional credit to cover a 14-day VPC pilot while our security team reviews evidence. If the evidence check passes, we'll move to a dedicated pilot (potentially larger commitment). If possible, please include:
- The list of required evidence and expected turnaround for review
- Any DPA template or link to sign
- Isolation/network guidance for our infra team

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our timeline and questions (horizon-compliance-questions.xlsx). Please loop in whoever on your side needs to approve credits tied to security gating.

Thanks,

We can do a compliance-linked sandbox allowance for a Private/VPC pilot. Provisional offer: 30k tokens for a 14-day window, contingent on the security evidence checklist and execution of a DPA. Our security lead will need to validate the attestation docs; turnaround is typically 48–72 business hours once we have the materials.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll loop in Sean (cc’d) who owns the MAP/credits flow.
2) Karthik from security will send the checklist and acceptance criteria.
3) Once Horizon returns the SOC2 attestation and signed DPA, we’ll apply the credit and schedule the VPC provisioning window.

I’ve copied a quick summary below and attached the initial MAP draft Sean will fill in.

Attachment: map-horizon-v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Thanks — I’ll keep this moving on our side.

Rajeev, thanks for looping us in. 

Attached is the security evidence checklist we require for a compliance-linked credit. Provisional credit will be held for 72 business hours after receipt of the checklist items; credit will be posted once we confirm the SOC2 attestation and see a signed DPA (DocuSign link above). If your SOC2 report is in process but not yet issued, we can accept an SOC2 type II bridge letter plus a self-attestation from your security officer, but that will limit the credit to a smaller initial tranche until final attestation is available.

Required items (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report OR bridge letter + security officer attestation
- Signed DPA (DocuSign)
- Network diagram + CIDR ranges for VPC peering / firewall rules
- Data retention and access control summary

Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.pdf

Once you send the items, I’ll validate and provide the acceptance stamp (or list any gaps). Turnaround: typically 48–72 business hours, occasionally longer if we need to request clarifications.

Thanks,
